description:
Matrix complete, over all 104 /api/v1 routes (51 mutating). Columns checked: token ability (EnsureApiTokenAbility middleware), tenant ownership, policy authorization, and host execution. Method bodies were expanded one level into same-class private helpers, because most controllers keep the org check in a guard method - without that expansion 31 routes read as gaps and every one was a false positive.

Result: tenancy is universal. Every mutating route verifies the caller's organization owns the resource; no route is missing one.

The gap was the policy layer on host-executing routes: 8 of 10 commands.run routes checked ability and org membership and then did work on the box without asking whether the caller may change that server (ISS-009 -> fixed in T-022). Filed and fixed rather than left as a report, since the fix was one call per route.

Not gaps, recorded so a future audit does not re-flag them: auth/device/start and auth/device/poll carry no ability by design (they are how a token is obtained); sites.env.* correctly uses sites.write rather than commands.run, because writing an env file is not host execution.
title: API v1 authorization matrix
